# Bound coordinate-cache proposal

This proposes one source change: compute `xFloat := float64(x)` once after the existing signed remainder and use it in the unchanged `n.slope*xFloat+n.offset` expression. `SOURCE-DIFF.source` is review text only. Neither qualified Go nor the existing unselected candidate payload is edited; no overlay, new module, test execution, profile or timing exists for this proposal. The intended source starts from qualified e492 original bytes, without bundling the prior `insertRange` change.

The signed coordinate remains between -2047 and 2047 and converts exactly to finite float64 bits, including positive zero for integer zero. Tree selection, negative-frame behavior, every node/epoch read, traversal branch, multiply/add/max operation and all node state stay unchanged. Conversion moves before the first epoch check: a stale root now incurs one unused conversion where the original incurs none. This work-placement difference is explicit and can offset a benefit.

The accepted profiles recorded 76/78 `bound` self samples; they motivate investigation, without identifying conversion cost. `COMPILER-OBSERVATION.json` pins the identical existing 928-byte WASM function bodies and a decoded conversion feeding multiply/add. Constant dispatch is tracked in a static call-free cycle, with other branch conditions abstract. This rules out a cached float64 operand in that Go-emitted expression, without proving dynamic instruction counts or V8 optimized-code behavior. V8 may already hoist it. Reject a future compiled candidate if it leaves the same work or changes arithmetic/state behavior; no speedup or 192 kHz deadline conclusion follows now.

`PLAN.json` requires independent frozen-original control, exact IEEE results and all 8,192 nodes after each setup/mutation and around each read-only query batch, including stale/dirty epochs, every signed residual, NaN payloads, signed zero, large/negative clocks, reset/wrap/clipped rebuild and zero query allocation. The refined plan fixes 562 batches, 1,686 complete state scans, 41,435,136 field comparisons and at most 124,776 query node visits. Every one of 4,911 paired query results remains exact; the allocation gate adds 576 calls. These are planned gates, not test passes. Reuse exact sealed original baseline native/WASM modules and evidence when all source/compiler/build/test contracts match; separately release only the new candidate pair by default. A possible new test-only control overlay must be explicit and reviewed. Source admission, compiler inspection and actual full-chain/original invariants precede any timing proposal. Candidate unselected; steady RED and cross-target full-state uncertainty remain open.
